title: Forms Plugin Migration To Crate And Taxonomy Consolidation
description: Migrate the 📋️forms plugin (single-app, single-artifact) from its 7-crate constitutional layout into ONE crate at ✏️s/🔌️plugins/📋️forms/📦️packages/🦀️rust/ with the full taxonomy source tree, following the W1 flow pilot's TEMPLATE.md exactly. Old crates: 🛂️manifest/🗿️artifact, 🎛️apps/📋️forms/⚡️implementations (facade), 🎛️apps/📋️forms/🔨️modules/{⚙️engine,🔧️op,🗣️dsl,🎒️pack,📡️protocol,🖱️ui}. Preserve package name, all [package.metadata.*] verbatim. Exclusive ownership: everything under ✏️s/🔌️plugins/📋️forms/**. Do not touch root Cargo.toml, root script.ts, registry script, launch.json, other plugins, or AGENTS.md. Verify with cargo check (native + wasm32-wasip2), clippy -D warnings, cargo test (wire-format-diff proof), all synchronous (never backgrounded). Report registrar handoff (exact root Cargo.toml lines to remove/add) instead of editing root files myself.
summary:
Migrated the 📋️forms plugin from its 7-crate constitutional layout into one crate at ✏️s/🔌️plugins/📋️forms/📦️packages/🦀️rust (semio-s-plugin-forms) with the full taxonomy tree: 🗿️artifacts/📋️forms/{component,diff,op,dsl,pack,spr,engine}, 🎛️apps/📋️forms/{component,config,terminology}, 10 🎮️commands/* groups (28 command rows total, decomposed via app_commands!), one 🎭️modes/📝️blueprint mode with 2 🪟️windows (🧱️builder=BlockList, ▶️try=Canvas2d), and 3 📌️panels (document/catalogue/inspection). Forms' document domain (FormSpec/FormQuestion/FormOperation/FormDiff) is re-exported from the shared `playbook` kernel crate throughout, matching flow's flow_core pattern.

Fixed the same systemic pre-existing bug batch-1 found in cad/vcs/shooting/sourcing/animate: the old 🖱️ui crate's handle() match arms had broken `Ok(Emit::config(...)` (missing close-paren) and bare `Emit{...}` struct-literal returns with no `Ok()` wrapper at all — the crate could not have compiled as committed. Fixed as a natural side effect of decomposing into app_commands! handlers.

Caught and fixed a real wire-format ordinal bug before it shipped: grouping commands by file (question.rs holding AddQuestion/RemoveQuestion/PatchQuestions/MoveQuestion/DropQuestionKind together) initially reordered MoveQuestion/DropQuestionKind ahead of PatchQuestionOptions/AddQuestionOption/RemoveQuestionOption/PatchVectorField/AddVectorField/RemoveVectorField relative to the pre-migration protocol crate's actual binary variant ordinal. Found via manual row-by-row comparison against the original enum (round-trip tests cannot catch pure reordering), fixed by keeping the app_commands! table's row order equal to the original ordinal regardless of which command file each payload lives in.

All wire keywords copied verbatim from the pre-migration `forms_protocol::FormsCommand`'s `#[dsl(key=...)]` attributes, including 5 non-kebab-case shortenings (setSelection->\"selection\", setTryValue->\"try-value\", setTryValues->\"try-values\", setSpecJson->\"spec-json\", setActiveExample->\"active-example\") plus the 2 host-pushed ones (setLocale->\"locale\", setContributions->\"contributions\") — all pinned in a permanent wire-keyword test.

Verification (all synchronous, all green): cargo check (native + wasm32-wasip2), cargo clippy --all-targets -D warnings (zero warnings in this crate; the one remaining warning is pre-existing in the semio-framework-plugin dependency), cargo test (88/88 passing covering every taxonomy node). Old 7 crate directories deleted only after all checks passed.

Cross-cutting fix (outside forms' own directory, per TEMPLATE §8.2 - every migrating agent hits this): 🧰️framework/🛍️products/💻️os/🔨️modules/🗣️dsl/🧪️fixture-sweep's Cargo.toml + lib.rs repointed `FormSpec` from the now-deleted `forms` app-facade crate straight to `playbook::PlaybookSpec` (its real owner - forms never overrode `#[dsl(extension=...)]` so this was always just an alias); confirmed this crate still compiles clean.

Demonstrator's `consumes = [\"forms.questionKind\", ...]` confirmed to be capability metadata only, no Cargo dependency - no action needed, not touched.

Did NOT touch root Cargo.toml, root script.ts, registry script, launch.json, or any other plugin's directory. Registrar handoff block included in the final chat report.
